d: Sanju Samson knows what it takes to fight his way back into the Indian cricket team. After being dropped, shuffled down the batting order and left out, Samson finally had his moment at the 2026 T20 World Cup. But against New Zealand, with 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi waiting for an opportunity to open when Ishan Kishan was injured, Samson was willing to move down the order. Why does that decision matter, especially coming from a player who has experienced the uncertainty of international cricket himself? Rupha Ramani looks at Sanju Samson's selflessness, India's team-first culture and…
